signal-violet.$description: Signal Violet — Primary brand color — hero backgrounds, CTAs, interactive states, logo mark. The electric quality (vivid, high-chroma) makes every surface it touches feel charged.

deep-nebula.$description: Deep Nebula — Hero section footer tone and gradient terminus. Paired with Signal Violet for the dark-to-darker hero gradient that creates depth within the purple field.

iris-mid.$description: Iris Mid — Button shadow underlay and hover states on the hero. Creates tactile depth on dark surfaces via box-shadow layering.

soft-amethyst.$description: Soft Amethyst — Secondary headline text on dark violet backgrounds — brand color carried into typography so the hero never loses chromatic identity.

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Pill button accent variant — appears as a pastel contrast button against the violet hero. Black text on this color delivers AAA contrast with brand warmth.

powder-violet.$description: Powder Violet — Feature card illustration tints and ghost typography in the white sections — keeps brand hue present without saturating light backgrounds.

periwinkle-glow.$description: Periwinkle Glow — Icon fills and glow halos (box-shadow on interactive elements). The lighter violet relative of Signal Violet — used for SVG fills and hover glow effects.

celestial-cyan.$description: Celestial Cyan — Decorative accent surface — appears sparingly as a cool counterpoint to the warm violet system.

ink.$description: Ink — Primary heading text on white sections.

slate.$description: Slate — Body text on white sections, secondary navigation labels.

steel.$description: Steel — Tertiary body copy, fine print, disabled states.

fog.$description: Fog — Icon strokes, placeholder text, muted UI elements.

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Card borders, section dividers, input borders on light surfaces.

chalk.$description: Chalk — Page background for feature sections.

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, nav background, text on dark hero.

carbon.$description: Carbon — CTA button fill on the hero (the dark pill that contrasts with the violet field), high-contrast body text.

deep-violet-text.$description: Deep Violet Text — Body copy within violet/dark sections where pure white would be too harsh.

hero-gradient.$description: Hero Gradient — Full-bleed hero background — Signal Violet to Deep Nebula vertical gradient with radial glow at top center.

nan-jaune-midi-bold.$description: Hero and section display headlines exclusively. The custom font's chunky stroke contrast and tight tracking at display sizes creates broadcast-title energy — unmistakable at a glance, nothing Inter could replicate. The aggressive negative tracking (-0.054em at 56px) squeezes letters into a dense typographic block that reads as a single graphic unit.

inter.$description: All UI text: navigation, body copy, subheadings, card titles, buttons, captions. Weight 700 at 24-30px for section subheadings; weight 600 at 18-20px for card headers; weight 500 at 14-16px for body and UI labels. The utilitarian pairing with NaN Jaune Midi is intentional — Inter stays invisible so the display font commands full attention.

sans-serif.$description: System fallback at 12px for fine-print labels and browser-rendered micro text.
